sources.title: Family account given by Sebastian Belfiore, with answers from his mother Amanda
sources.note: Includes: Reg was Amanda's grandfather, Bob his brother, and Babs 'my auntie'; Ronald, Patricia and Herbert have all died; Patricia was born in Windsor, lost her mother young and was evacuated in the war; Reg died of an illness linked to smoking; Ron and Pat met through Sandra's parents.
